title: Location-allocation: 2-median
query: demand.csv has 40 demand points with populations, and candidates.csv has 8 candidate facility sites. Choose the 2 sites that minimise the total population-weighted straight-line distance from each demand point to its nearest chosen site. Which two sites, and what is that total in person-kilometres?

expected_why.sites: exhaustive over all 28 pairs, geodesic distances

answer:
## Optimal Solution

**The two sites that minimize total population-weighted distance are C1 and C3:**

- **C1** (coordinates: 41.88899, -87.63185)
- **C3** (coordinates: 41.85090, -87.71800)

**Total population-weighted straight-line distance: 382,254 person-kilometres** (approximately 382,254.14 person-km)

## Method

For each pair:
- Every one of the 40 demand points was assigned to its **nearest** of the two sites
- Distances were calculated using the **haversine formula** (great-circle distance) in kilometres
- The total was computed as: Σ (population × nearest distance)

## Top 5 Candidate Pairs

| Rank | Pair | Total (person-km) |
|------|------|-------------------|
| 1 | **C1 + C3** | **382,254** |
| 2 | C2 + C3 | 418,880 |
| 3 | C7 + C8 | 420,411 |
| 4 | C1 + C7 | 423,999 |
| 5 | C3 + C7 | 428,723 |
